Earlier build used 0.9 in","provenance":"drawn from CAPR 39-1 Fig A5-8 \"Cadet Airman and NCO flight cap\" device: blue disc, silver rim, silver wings, red propeller","anchors":{"top_center":[67.88888888888889,0],"bottom_center":[67.88888888888889,135.77777777777777],"center":[67.88888888888889,67.88888888888889],"left_edge":[0,67.88888888888889],"right_edge":[135.77777777777777,67.88888888888889],"mount_center":[67.88888888888889,67.88888888888889]},"dimensions":{"diameter_in":1.3,"form":"round pin-on device","rim":"silver","field":"blue","emblem":"silver wings with red propeller"},"mounts":[{"uniform":"USAF-style flight cap (Class A / Class B / FDU)","rule":"front left flap, centred halfway between the top and bottom of the flap, 1 1/2 in back from the front of the cap (6.2.2.2.2-3; Senior Member NCOs per ICL 25-02 (g))"},{"uniform":"Service cap","rule":"Senior Member NCOs wear the NCO device centred on the front of the cap (6.2.1.1.1 as changed by ICL 25-02)"}],"documented":["cadet NCOs and Airmen wear the metal Cadet Airman flight cap insignia (6.2.2.2.3)","Senior Member NCOs wear the NCO device (ICL 25-02 (g), Fig A5-8/9)"],"assumed":["diameter","wing and propeller proportions (figure device is ~35 px across)"]}
